description: Branch R-FMT-2 Binary and OLE (public side) on an ACCDB. BB(ID Long, B Binary(255), L LongBinary): row 1 B = bytes 0..254 and L = all 256 byte values; row 2 B = 255 zero bytes and L = one zero byte; row 3 B and L empty arrays; row 4 both Null; row 5 B = one 0xFF byte and L = a 4000-byte pattern; row 6 B = 256 bytes (over the field size, with a marked Errors read). Reads the arrays back through a recordset and the lengths through SQL. Asks whether every byte value round-trips, whether an empty array reads back as Null or empty, and what an over-long Binary does.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
